title: Rukna Mana Hai! 🚀
hook_line: Agar zindagi mein koi bada maqsad hai, toh rukna bilkul mana hai.
caption:
Kya aapka lakshya aapko har din kuch naya karne ki shakti deta hai? 🚀

Jayashankar Prasad ji ki ye behtareen lines ko share karein unke saath jo aaj thoda thak gaye hain.

Save this for whenever you need a boost! ✨
meaning_note: Yeh kavita humein himmat aur hausle ke saath apne raste par aage badhne ki prerana deti hai. Jab maqsad bada ho, toh rukna mana hai!
reasons: Very high demand evidence (2.6L+ views on related content).
Low saturation of near-duplicates makes this a fresh choice.
High emotional payoff with the 'Rukna nahi hai' call to action.
